title: PreparedAction
description: A consequential action that has been validated by the host application and prepared by the core, waiting for confirmation (master plan 11.2, 11.4, ADR 0006). Nothing reaches an adapter's Commit unless a PreparedAction exists, is unexpired and still current. The model may verbalise it; it cannot create or alter it: every property is 'alixai' (minted or decided by the core) or 'host' (copied from the adapter's Prepare result), none is 'model'.

preparation_id.description: Opaque preparation ID. A confirmation is bound to it.

capability_id.description: The registered capability this action was prepared for.

state.description: Lifecycle state (internal/actions): prepared, confirmed, committing, then committed, rejected, expired, invalidated or uncertain. A preparation announced to the user is prepared.

summary.description: Canonical action summary from the host application's Prepare result.

effects.description: The exact effects and their targets, from the host's Prepare result. The user confirms these.

risk_level.description: Effective risk level: the platform minimum for the capability, raised (never lowered) by the host's declared level. Always present; a missing level is never read as 0.

data_versions.description: The versions of everything the validation relied on, from the host's Prepare result. Commit re-checks them; any difference makes the preparation stale.

prepared_at.description: When the core created the preparation.

expires_at.description: When the preparation stops being valid: the earlier of the platform limit and the host's valid_for_seconds, from the core's clock. After this instant a confirmation is rejected with expired.

invalidation_conditions.description: Events that void the preparation before it expires. data_version_changed is always among them.

confirmation.description: What must happen before the action may commit.

idempotency_key.description: Key sent with Commit and Status so a repeated or recovered commit produces the same outcome.

allOf.description: 11.4: level 2 and above are never executed without confirmation.
11.4: level 3 needs step-up; the AI cannot complete it alone.
11.4: an external side effect is level 2 or higher.
